items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I know that the Berks Jazz Festival here in PA, the festival director John Onester just wrote to everybody and said...

ctx.x: Were any of the people that cancelled, did they try to do their best to say well we’re going to reschedule?

Yeah, in some cases I pursued it right away, like for example in March we were scheduled, usually DIVA does four nights at Dizzy’s Club in New York City, at Jazz at Lincoln Center every March, it’s our birthday and we’ve been playing there since the club opened. So we were scheduled in March to do a brand new live recording, “DIVA Swings Broadway” and it was cancelled, and I didn’t even fiddle around with trying to say well we’ll come in the fall. I just said please just put us down for next March, so we have our…
Yeah. We’re hoping that those venues and festivals can still exist in 2021.
